## What's new

- Display Mode, in each console's menu and the in-game menu: Integer, Aspect or Stretch, saved per console. In a game it changes as you press it.
- Every shader now draws at any size, so the CRT, Scanlines, lcd3x and PT shaders all work in Aspect and Stretch too.
- PT's Grid follows the game's pixels, so it's shown and drawn only in Integer. In Aspect and Stretch its rows are hidden.
- Game Boy, Game Boy Color and Game Boy Advance get a Style row: PT SkyWalker541 or lcd3x, a simple LCD grid that looks the same at any size.
- PT's LCD Dot effect is gone. It was too slow to keep games at full speed. A console that used it comes back with Grid.
- ChaOS Pixel Names: the reflection now shows each letter in its own colour, so the white letters reflect white.
- ChaOS-diatom 0.9.3.

---

ChaOS 0.12.0 for the TrimUI Brick and Brick Hammer.

**Install or update** with [ChaOS Installer](https://github.com/SkyWalker541/ChaOS-Installer/releases/latest), or write `ChaOS-v0.12.0-brick.img.xz` to a card yourself (that erases it).

ChaOS is built on [TortOS 2.1.1](https://github.com/ericreinsmidt/TortOS/releases/tag/v2.1.1) by Eric Reinsmidt. `ChaOS-v0.12.0-brick-sources.tar` is the source of everything in the image; what came from where is in [CREDITS.md](https://github.com/SkyWalker541/ChaOS/blob/main/CREDITS.md).
